A few answers

Frequently asked questions.

Still curious? Send us a note and we’ll be happy to talk through your plans.

How early should we book?

Ideally, couples should begin planning several months before the wedding so there is time to make thoughtful decisions.

Do you work with outside vendors?

Yes. We can work with vendors selected by the couple or recommend trusted professionals.

Do you plan destination weddings?

Yes. Destination wedding planning can be included depending on the location and requirements.

Can we customize a package?

Yes. Packages can be adjusted according to the couple’s needs.
